translations.web: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.
translations.bsb: Although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I have already pronounced judgment on the one who did this, just as if I were present.
translations.kjv: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath ➔ so done this deed,
translations.asv: For I verily, being absent in body but present in spirit, have already as though I were present judged him that hath so wrought this thing,
